channel.title: South Sudan - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from South Sudan, every source cited.

item.title: Juba City Council digitizes revenue collection
item.description: The council arrested 32 employees and launched a public website to improve financial transparency.

item.title: SSPDF reunites two abducted children with parents in Juba
item.description: Two-year-old Abi Gatwich Tuach and five-year-old Simon Gattiek Tut Kai were recovered from Gumuruk Town.

item.title: Kiir returns to Juba after Russia summit
item.description: Russia increased scholarship places for South Sudanese students to 40 for the 2026-2027 academic year.

item.title: Stephen Dhieu wins SPLM gubernatorial primaries in Upper Nile
item.description: Dhieu secured 120 votes, defeating former governor Jacob Dollar and becoming the party's flag bearer for December 2026 elections.

item.title: UK gives South Sudan $2.8 million for flood preparedness
item.description: Funding will support early warning systems and aid for communities in Jonglei, Unity, and Upper Nile states.
